announcements.headline: ASM reports third quarter 2026 results
announcements.insight: As a dominant player in semiconductor equipment, ASM International's Q3 results provide critical real-time data on global fab capex cycles and the pace of advanced packaging adoption. The outcome will directly influence market sentiment regarding the durability of the current semiconductor recovery and demand visibility for peers like ASML and Applied Materials.
